pages.text: Forget the experts for a moment. I want to talk about shares today. Take a patient long-term view and hold on. Reinvest your earnings every year and let time do the work. Brokers charge only 0.5 percent, so trading costs next to nothing.

Shares represent part ownership of a listed company and are traded through licensed brokers on the exchange. Share prices move with company results, market sentiment and the wider economy. Share this with a friend who needs to hear it. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
